description: Elections Commission - T. A. J. Perera, L. C. Duminda and P. N. N. Jayathilaka of the Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and local government member status, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including candidate registrations, vacancies, and electoral commission decisions.
